Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Is watching a bright screen (computer/TV) in the dark damaging to your eyes?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your eyes are like little cameras that like to see things clearly. When you watch a bright screen in the dark, your eyes have to work extra hard, because the screen is much brighter than the room around you.

It’s a little bit like trying to look at a flashlight in a dark closet—it can be hard and make your eyes feel tired. But, it’s not going to break your eyes or make them stop working. It might make your eyes feel tired, sore, or itchy after a while, because your eyes are getting tired from focusing on the bright light for too long in the dark.

So, it’s not super dangerous, but it’s not the best thing for your eyes either. It’s better to have some gentle light in the room when you watch TV or use the computer, so your eyes don’t have to work so hard. That way, your eyes will feel happier!
